dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "A light shines from an island to our west... Maybe it's the smugglers' stolen booty..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "The situation in Higi Village goes most ill. Gongozaemon is the best swordsman among us and was still in fairly good shape..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...So he was dispatched to confront the village chief about whether he's hidden any deserters... So far, he hasn't returned... Yamada was sent to issue a warning..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...If he fails to return in another half an hour, we will regard the village as having assisted traitors, and they shall be executed immediately..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...Many villagers came out, but not the village chief. Something doesn't seem right..."
